attributes.title: NJAFP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: New Jersey Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey Academy of Family Physicians has set its 2027 Annual Meeting for Friday, April 30, through Sunday, May 2, at the Tropicana Boardwalk Resort and Casino in Atlantic City. It is the academy's main yearly gathering for family doctors in the state.

When we checked, the academy had posted only a save-the-date notice with the dates and venue. Program, credit hours, fees and room rates were not out yet. The NJAFP events page is where registration should appear once it opens.
